name: Band Pushdown
cues: Anchor the band above head height
Hold the ends with your elbows tucked at your sides
Push down until your arms are straight
Let your hands rise to chest height without moving your elbows

qa.note: Wave 3b 2026-10-09: rated ok by the lane review, auto-approved. ok: Elbow goes 4 to 108 with the upper arm 18 to 21 deg forward. Both strands run from the post hook (2.0 m) to the handles with at least 26 mm clearance from the forearms (my band check). Balance is within 33 of 50 mm, and the hands rise to about lower-chest height at the stretch, as cue 4 says.
